{{Attr|Aggro}} (Variable) |event_ability1 = '''{{WikiAb|Fragmentation}}''' - Upon death, the '''Snow Golem''' spawns three [[Snowman|Snowmen]]. }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Snow Golem''' is a summoner enemy that appears in the [[Frost Mode|Frost]] mode. Like most of that mode's enemies, it first appeared in the [[Operation I.C.E Event]]. It has high health and average speed. When killed, it will summon two [[Nimble]] [[Snowman|Snowmen]], which have less health than it but are faster. ==Logbook Description== "''Like the Snowman, the Snow Golem was created from energized ice debris found in the depths of the Frost Realm. These massive beings emerge when Snowmen, locked in battles for dominance, become consumed by their fury and merge into a single, towering Golem. When defeated, the Snowmen entangled are freed.''" ==Appearance== The '''Snow Golem''' is a humanoid with elongated, straight arms, a cylindrical head and a hunched back. It is an entity created from two [[Snowman|Snowmen]] merging with each other. It has two pebbles for eyes, a carrot for a nose and a stick which resembles a unibrow. On its torso it has three black pebbles that resemble buttons, with multiple sticks poking out of its back. ==Strategy== *Decent early-game towers like the [[Golden Scout]], [[Operator]], [[Saboteur]], [[Golden Soldier]] or [[Electroshocker]] can be used. **Towers with AOE are especially useful due to it summoning multiple enemies on death. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseSnowGolem.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} SnowGolemIconIG.png|'''Snow Golem''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Snow Golem''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''16 December 2024''' -
